paper.locator: Sections 2.1–2.2. A third piezoresistive probe touches the object from above. The paper uses a decline in summed contact for slip onset and loss of both gripping contacts for the end.

signals: Raw Myrmex left/right images are 16×16 float32. UBI0All is 5 banks of 12 unsigned 16-bit distal fields, with values 0–1023 in first bank and all remaining banks zero in this release. Use inverted first-bank sum 12×1023 − sum(raw counts) as an uncalibrated strength proxy. Compare only streams with actual messages and keep the full available coverage.
method: Use ROS Header nanoseconds for comparisons. Store bag-record minus Header offsets separately (software times; hardware synchronization accuracy not established by close stamps alone). Define start/end strengths as medians of first/last 250ms. For a decline greater than 10×max(1,1.4826×starting MAD), find first downward crossing of midpoint after initial 250ms with at least 10ms continuously under threshold. Report half-drop times only when both participating streams qualify. Preserve missing and unstable cases; the comparator is an offline whole-window statistic, not the authors’ online slip-onset detector.
collection_note: The paper describes 64 trials. The archived tar enumerates 63 bag members, 62 with the overhead probe; the absent trial cannot be reconstructed from the paper count. Of 44 files without stable in the name, 33 yield half-drop landmarks on all three channels. None of the 18 stable-named files with a present overhead probe yields that probe landmark.
limits: The third probe is a separate physical contact with the same transduction principle. No calibrated per-taxel normal force, electrical switch edge, optical motion truth or explicit ground-truth slip timestamp topic is in these bag files. A waveform difference measures response and geometry as well as any timing differences. Stable/rotate/down filename categories indicate conditions, not frame annotations.
reproduce: Download complete original tar.bz2 and verify listed MD5. Extract .bag members under INPUT_DIR. Run python derive_slip.py INPUT_DIR OUT with rosbags and numpy; no bag conversion or ROS installation is required.
